name: cache-keepalive
description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm: after ~55 idle minutes it replays the cached prefix with a tiny fork so the next turn doesn't pay a full cache write.

idleMinutes.title: Ping after idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last main-thread request that read or wrote the cache before a keep-alive ping is sent (1-58; the 1-hour cache lapses 60 minutes after that request was sent).

maxPings.title: Max consecutive pings
maxPings.description: Keep-alives sent in a row while you are away before giving up (each one re-reads the whole cached prefix). 0 means no limit.
